files.reaper.md:
Notes from Tuesday.

## Fix the reaper
The reaper leaves zombie processes behind.
Restart it when it exits.

steps.line: * Given a notebook with "## Fix the reaper" folded is open

expect.why: "## Fix the reaper" is the one folded heading

expect.that: (.folded.json.sections.notebook.folded[0].offset) as $h | .folded.json.sections.notebook.drawn | any(.offset == $h and (.text | startswith("## Fix the reaper")))
expect.why: the notebook is open in the window with the folded heading shown

steps.line: * When the window's accessibility tree is read

expect.why: the window's accessibility tree was read

steps.line: * Then the folded marker of "## Fix the reaper" has the label "Folded"

expect.that: (.shown.json.sections.notebook.folded[] | select(.line == "## Fix the reaper") | .offset) as $h | [.shown.json.sections.notebook.markers[] | select(.heading == $h)] | length == 1
expect.why: the window shows the folded marker beside "## Fix the reaper"

expect.that: (.shown.json.sections.notebook.folded[] | select(.line == "## Fix the reaper") | .offset) as $h | [.shown.json.sections.notebook.markers[] | select(.heading == $h) | .label] == ["Folded"]
expect.why: palantir gives the folded marker of "## Fix the reaper" itself the accessibility label "Folded"

expect.that: (.shown.json.sections.notebook.folded[] | select(.line == "## Fix the reaper") | .offset) as $h | (.shown.json.sections.notebook.markers[] | select(.heading == $h) | .rect) as $m | (.tree.elements | min_by(.depth) | .frame) as $w | ($w[0] + $m.x + $m.width / 2) as $x | ($w[1] + $w[3] - .shown.json.window.content.height + $m.y + $m.height / 2) as $y | any(.tree.elements[]; .label == "Folded" and (.frame | type) == "array" and .frame[0] <= $x and $x <= .frame[0] + .frame[2] and .frame[1] <= $y and $y <= .frame[1] + .frame[3])
expect.why: the accessibility tree read shows an element labeled "Folded" where that marker is, placed from the tree's window frame
